name: Host Caps Test
description: A tiny app used by the loader's CDP test (run E): it asks for the screen, the mouse and keyboard, tools and MCP servers, and exposes each through an invoke handler.

host.purpose: Reads the screen to help you fill forms
Clicks and types for you when you ask
Runs the tools you allow, like screencapture
Uses apps that offer MCP tools, like VS Code
